title: Amrita Pandey joins Hammurabi & Solomon as Partner in Kolkata
description: Amrita Pandey has joined Hammurabi & Solomon Partners as a Partner in Dispute Resolution practice in Kolkata.Pandey is an alumna of WB National University of Juridical Sciences. She earned her LLM from O.P. Jindal Global University.Pandey has over 16 years of extensive experience in litigation, dispute resolution, and regulatory advisory. She has built a distinguished practice representing clients before the Calcutta High Court, National Green Tribunal (NGT), National Company
